lead: A web preview: a sandboxed iframe with an address bar (Enter to navigate), reload and open in a new tab. The content is either an address or a piece of HTML. By default only scripts and forms are allowed and the frame is cross-origin, so it cannot read the host's data; addresses must be http(s).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Many sites forbid being embedded (`X-Frame-Options`); this one allows it.

html.title: HTML content
html.description: `html` is rendered through `srcdoc`, so pages generated by AI can be previewed directly.
html.heading: Hello from a sandbox
html.text: This page lives in srcdoc and runs in a cross-origin sandbox.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.action: The reload button and the open-in-new-tab link
styling.url: Address bar (`input`; `aria-invalid` when the address is invalid)
styling.frame: The iframe and the loading bar (`role=status`)
